description: Narrowing inside a block body, in concert with tier 9c's iterators and clink 11's capIntact: `t.each do |x| y = [10,20][x]; if y then s = s + y end end`. The nilable comes from Array#[] inside the block, the narrowing happens in the block's own environment, and the accumulation into the captured `s` is legal only because it preserves s's type -- the boundary xc-block-accumulates-capture pins. Deliberately the messiest rung in the tier.
